title: Fish Farming
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Delivery

Quest Description: Talk to the Sir Temdewm on level 2 of Vegrim's Vexation.

Quest Reward: 2,125 Gold

Return to: Sir Temdewm

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go and Talk to Sir Tendewm on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation.

Offer:

If you are willing, I would like to employ you as my personal cat food hunter gatherer. Go and talk to Sir Tendewm on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation and tell him about our arrangement. He will serve as your liaison for collecting the cat food from here on out.

Turn-in:

Oh, Audrey sent you did she? She isn't looking for her imaginary husband again is she? Or even worse, her imaginary herd of cats? Oh, you are here to collect the cat food for her... Look, I won't tell her if you won't. She is a lovely lady and I'm sure she does something with those fish even if she doesn't actually have any cats.

Client level range: 17–30
